status: DirectDraw object identity, activation and attachment batch verified locally; original Wine DDraw1 remains incomplete and failing.
changes: Separate Surface1/2/3/4/7 public reference counts, canonical Surface1 IUnknown, legacy Texture aggregation and cached Surface-owned Device1 identity; retain implicit creator references and private parent lifetimes.
Implement the three DirectDraw/Clipper COM class factories, one-shot initialization and unload bookkeeping.
Implement legacy viewport attachment validation and both descriptor conversions; keep v1 initialization semantics.

Match mip attachment queries by actual caps and retain COMPLEX on the leaf; prevent manual flip-ring corruption, restore attach/detach roles, preserve native root pin on removal, and require the front buffer to initiate Flip.
Correct auto-flip root/child roles and backbuffer metadata; detach a primary palette before freeing it, preventing the original GetPalette use-after-free.
